name: ai-sdlc
description: The six-stage AI-native software development lifecycle from Anthropic's playbook, as an executable Codex plugin. Each stage produces one version-controlled Markdown artifact and stops at a human gate: Plan writes intent.md, Design turns an accepted intent into spec.md under org policy, Build reviews plan.md before writing any code and then implements it, Test proves the change and regression-tests the agent configuration itself, Deploy runs the REVIEW.md passes on the PR with a verifier pass and a round cap and stops for human approval, Maintain watches bands.yaml control bands and files the next intent.md when a band breaks. A change a person declares low-risk takes the fast path, entering at Build; the hooks refuse it for any sensitive path. Ships eight skills, two read-only subagents, artifact-gate and prod-guard hooks, and templates for intent.md, spec.md, plan.md, review-findings.md, project memory (written to AGENTS.md for Codex, CLAUDE.md for Claude Code, from one template so the two cannot drift), REVIEW.md and bands.yaml. Every hook is inert unless the repository contains a .sdlc/ directory.

interface.shortDescription: Six-stage lifecycle with a human gate at every handoff
interface.longDescription: Runs software delivery as a loop of committed Markdown artifacts instead of role handoffs: intent.md, spec.md, plan.md, a reviewed PR, then control-band monitoring that files the next intent.md. Skills drive each stage, subagents run the review passes and diagnose control-band breaches, and hooks enforce the gates at the tool layer -- no source write for a change without an accepted plan.md, and no production command without explicit human authorization. Installing this plugin cannot change behavior in a repository that has not opted in: every hook exits immediately unless a .sdlc/ directory exists.
